title: Implement FT-001 session API routes and error contract

Validation and auth errors use stable codes and redacted safe messages.

evidence_required: Set-Cookie evidence for agro_intellect_session name, HttpOnly, SameSite=Lax, Path=/, Max-Age=604800, Expires/session_expires_at alignment, and loopback versus HTTPS Secure behavior
logout clear-cookie evidence for agro_intellect_session with Max-Age=0, expired Expires, and idempotent missing/invalid session behavior
bearer-mode boundary evidence when bearer mode is implemented, including no-cookie emission and token_hash-only persistence
Recommended T3 verify/red-verify/human checkpoint/owner closure evidence
constraints: Expose only POST /api/session/login, POST /api/session/logout, and GET /api/session/me from the session HTTP contract.
Browser/PWA login uses only the agro_intellect_session cookie and must not include the raw session token in the JSON body.

Cookie attributes must follow FT-001: HttpOnly, SameSite=Lax, Path=/, default Max-Age=604800, Expires equal to LocalSession.expires_at, Secure=false only for explicit loopback HTTP and Secure=true for HTTPS or browser cookie use outside loopback.
Plain HTTP LAN browser cookie mode is forbidden; optional LAN browser mode requires HTTPS, explicit enablement, origin controls, and Secure=true.
Bearer mode is disabled by default for browser/PWA flows and, when explicitly enabled for non-browser/LAN clients, must not also set the session cookie.
Do not expose Account creation or first-Boss bootstrap routes from the session API.
AUTH_CREDENTIAL_INVALID must not reveal whether login exists.
Errors must not include passwords, tokens, credentials, .env values, API keys, raw provider payloads, or hidden reasoning.

Preserve verified FT-000 app factory, settings, database/session, migration, readiness, runtime-root, and redaction anchors per Foundation Runtime Substrate, Foundation Data Substrate, and Evidence Redaction specs; stop if implementation contradicts the brownfield baseline.
invariants: Every non-health route must resolve ActorContext before business logic unless explicitly public by feature spec.
Secrets/auth material must not enter logs, timeline, manifests, Bus, UI Feed, screenshots, exports, or agent context.
verification_targets: /red-verify semantic-pass when selected by the owner
Check changed code preserves linked Foundation Runtime Substrate, Foundation Data Substrate, Foundation Smoke API when relevant, and Evidence Redaction contracts or records a blocker.
Check FT-001 session route registration preserves Foundation Smoke API /health and /ready behavior.
Check login Set-Cookie uses agro_intellect_session with HttpOnly, SameSite=Lax, Path=/, Max-Age=604800, Expires aligned with session_expires_at, and correct Secure behavior for loopback versus HTTPS.
Check logout clears agro_intellect_session with matching name/path/samesite/secure mode, Max-Age=0, expired Expires, and idempotent 204 behavior for missing or invalid sessions.
Check bearer mode, if implemented, returns a raw token only once through the allowed non-browser/LAN boundary, emits no cookie, sets no-store cache behavior, and persists only token_hash.
Check session API errors match the FT-001 Error Contract and API Guidelines without leaking auth material.
purpose: Expose the FT-001 session API surface with stable safe errors and browser/PWA default session transport.
success_outcome: Clients can login, logout, and inspect the current safe session summary through FastAPI routes without leaking auth material.
anti_goals: No Account creation or bootstrap route.

forbidden_scope: raw auth material in responses or evidence
stop_conditions: Route behavior conflicts with FT-001 error contract.
Cookie attributes, clear-cookie behavior, or bearer-mode boundaries cannot be verified without leaking token material.
Browser/PWA session response includes the raw token outside the cookie transport.
Implementation requires adding Account creation or bootstrap outside this task scope.
Implementation contradicts verified FT-000 app/settings/database/session/redaction baseline.
